rows.when: a signal is written in a derivation (B5.1)
rows.message: Write to signal "{signal}" inside {kind} "{derivation}".
rows.hint: Derivations must be pure: compute it with computed()/linkedSignal(), or move the write to an event handler.

rows.when: a consumer ran more than 100 times in a flush, round 101, or 1,000 microtask flushes without a macrotask (B4.6, B4.10)
rows.message: {names} kept re-triggering each other ({runs} runs); DOM may be stale in: {bindings}.
rows.hint: A consumer writes state it reads: derive it with computed()/linkedSignal(), or make the write conditional so it converges.

rows.when: no provider and no default (B13.2)
rows.message: No provider for context "{name}" in {ownerPath}.
rows.hint: Wrap the subtree in provide({name}, value, () => ...) or give createContext a default. A consumer passed as children was created before the provider: pass () => Child.

rows.when: useContext with no owner (B13.3)
rows.message: useContext("{name}") was called outside component setup.
rows.hint: Call it during setup and keep the value in a const; handlers and code after await have no owner.

rows.when: mount() is called from a second copy of jasno, not the one that loaded first (B16.1)
rows.message: Two copies of jasno are loaded: {first} and {second}.
rows.hint: Import jasno only as '@jasno/core' and never write an import map: jasno dev and jasno dist generate it.

rows.when: mount(view, null) (B16.1)
rows.message: mount() got a null target.
rows.hint:
Add
to index.html and call mount(App, document.getElementById('app')).

rows.when: flush() in a derivation or setup (B4.2)
rows.message: flush() was called inside {context}.
rows.hint: Call flush() from tests, handlers, effects or onMount, never from computed() or setup.

rows.when: effect/resource/component/onMount/root/mount created in a derivation (B6.11)
rows.message: {kind} created inside {derivation}; derivations have no owner.
rows.hint: Create it in setup or onMount; computed() stays pure.

rows.when: createRouter with an unsupported pattern (B17.1)
rows.message: Route pattern "{pattern}" is not supported: {reason}.
rows.hint: Use '/'-rooted static segments, :name, :name?, :name+, :name*, :name(a|b); for unknown URLs, and instead of a pattern that matches every path, use createRouter(routes, { notFound }).

rows.when: a route can never match (B17.1)
rows.message: Route "{later}" can never match: "{earlier}" comes first and matches all of its paths.
rows.hint: List specific routes (/users/new) before param routes (/users/:id).

rows.when: a second live router.outlet()
rows.message: router.outlet() is already rendered in {ownerPath}.
rows.hint: Render router.outlet() exactly once, in App.

rows.when: navigate() or back() before outlet() rendered, or after its owner was disposed (B17.3, B17.13)
rows.message: router.{method}("{url}") was called before router.outlet() was rendered.
rows.hint: Mount the app first; in tests mountTest(t, () => App()) before navigate().

rows.when: a signal converted to a primitive
rows.message: Signal "{node}" was used as a value.
rows.hint: Call it: ${count()}, count() + 1.

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a value with a zero-parameter call signature (signal or Read) in + concatenation with a string or in String()
a function child returned a Node
rows.message: A function child in {ownerPath} returned <{tag}>; function children are live text.
rows.hint: Lists use each(list, { key, render }); switches use show(when, then, otherwise) or match(key, render).

rows.when: value() read in setup while idle/loading (B12.4)
rows.message: Resource "{node}" was read in {region} while {status}; that snapshot would stay undefined.
rows.hint: Read it inside a function: show(() => r.hasValue() && r.value(), (v) => ...).

rows.when: a component returned a non-Node
rows.message: Component <{name}> returned {type}, not a Node.
rows.hint: Return one element or a show/match/each region.

rows.when: read in setup (B12.4)
rows.message: Signal "{node}" was read directly in {region}; the value will not update.
rows.hint: Make it live: pass the signal or () => .... untracked() is only for values that must never update.

rows.when: read in a loader (B9.13)
rows.message: Signal "{node}" was read in the loader of resource "{resource}"; changing it will not reload.
rows.hint: Move the read into params: () => .... Use untracked() there only if a change must not reload.

rows.when: a derivation read only through untracked() (B12.6)
rows.message: {kind} "{node}" read nothing tracked; it can never update.
rows.hint: Read the signal directly; untracked() is for setup-time seeds only.

rows.when: an effect run wrote a signal that something observes, or that the effect itself read (B5.3)
rows.message: Effect "{effect}" wrote signal "{signal}" during its run.
rows.hint: Derive it with computed() or linkedSignal(), or write it in the event handler that caused the change; effects only sync the outside world. A subscription whose callback sets signals goes in onMount (a new route param builds a new view, so it restarts per param).

rows.when: an effect's first run read no signal
rows.message: Effect "{effect}" read no signals, so it never re-runs.
rows.hint: Use onMount() for one-time work, or read the signals it should react to.

rows.when: effect/onMount/resource/component with no owner (B6.8)
rows.message: {kind} created outside any owner at {loc}; it is never disposed.
rows.hint: Create it during setup or onMount; module-level app-lifetime work goes in createRoot(() => ...). signal() and computed() need no owner.

rows.when: setup wrote a signal it did not create (B5.4)
rows.message: Setup of {region} wrote "{signal}".
rows.hint: Rendering must not change other state: move the write to onMount() or a handler, or derive it.

rows.when: global listener or timer created in setup (B12.8)
rows.message: {api} was called during setup of {region}; it outlives the component.
rows.hint: Move it into onMount(({ abortSignal }) => ...) and pass { signal: abortSignal } or return a cleanup.

rows.when: set() while loading (B9.8)
rows.message: set() on resource "{node}" while it loads {params}; the value likely belongs to earlier params.
rows.hint: Capture the params before the await and write only if they are unchanged; optimistic values are set() before the await (this warning never fires in 'reloading').

rows.when: each saw a key twice
rows.message: each() in {ownerPath} got key {key} more than once.
rows.hint: Keys must be unique and stable, e.g. (item) => item.id.

rows.when: the key function disagreed with itself (B11.1)
rows.message: each() key in {ownerPath} returned {a}, then {b} for the same item.
rows.hint: Derive the key from the item, (item) => item.id; no random values, counters or Date.now().

rows.when: an unknown key reached h.* (also open on an element without it) (B15.8)
rows.message: <{tag}> got unknown prop "{key}".
rows.hint: Key-specific: onClick → onclick (event props are lowercase DOM names), className → class, for → htmlFor, ref → keep the element, key → each(); an unknown aria-* key lists the valid ones.

rows.when: a node that already has a parent was appended elsewhere (B15.6)
rows.message: <{tag}> already had a parent and was moved into {ownerPath}.
rows.hint: A node lives in one place: create it where it is used (a function returning a new node); render children once.

rows.when: a builder (a show/match branch, an each row, a catchError fallback) returned a node built outside it (B10.6)
rows.message: {builder} in {ownerPath} returned <{tag}>, created outside it.
rows.hint: Create the node inside the builder, or keep it mounted and toggle hidden: () => !open().

rows.when: interactive element, dialog, meter or progress without accessible name (B15.10)
rows.message: <{tag}> in {ownerPath} has no accessible name.
rows.hint: Add text, aria-label or aria-labelledby, or wrap it: h.label(null, 'Name', h.input(...)).

rows.when: an update removed, disabled or hid the focused element and nothing moved focus (B20; also a catchError swap into text-only content, B8.5, whose hint instead says to wrap the text in an element)
rows.message: Focus was on <{tag}> in {ownerPath}, which this update {action}; focus fell to <body>.
rows.hint: Keep the control enabled with 'aria-disabled', focus what replaced it in onMount, or focus something that stays before the change (a Retry inside show(): the status line).

rows.when: an Enter keydown handler returned without preventDefault() and focus moved to a button, link, summary, textarea or form field (B15.7)
rows.message: The Enter keydown handler in {ownerPath} moved focus from <{from}> to <{to}> without preventDefault(); in Chromium the same key press will activate <{to}>.
rows.hint: Call e.preventDefault() in that branch, or save through a form: h.form({ onsubmit: (e) => { e.preventDefault(); ... } }) handles Enter (RECIPES Inline edit).

rows.when: an onsubmit handler did not prevent navigation (B15.7)
rows.message: The submit handler of <form> in {ownerPath} did not call preventDefault(); the browser will navigate.
rows.hint: Call e.preventDefault() first in onsubmit.

rows.when: a flush disposed router.outlet() and rendered another one, as an outlet in each branch of a show does (B17.3)
rows.message: router.outlet() moved within one flush: the view is built again, its loader runs again, and focus does not move.
rows.hint: Render router.outlet() once, where it never switches; UI a section shares is a layout route (RECIPES: Layout).

rows.when: the router found no h1 or visible [autofocus] (B17.8)
rows.message: The view for "{route}" has no h1 or visible [autofocus]; the router focused <main>.
rows.hint: Render an h.h1 in every view, outside show/match (its text may be live).

rows.build: dev (the reload happens in both builds)
rows.when: a view or layout module failed to load (B17.17)
rows.message: The module for "{route}" failed to load ({error}); reloading {url}.
rows.hint: Usually a deploy replaced the files: keep previous deploys (npm run dist -- --keep 2).

rows.when: owners created by the test alive after unmount (B19.4)
rows.message: {n} owners created by this test are alive after unmount: {paths}.
rows.hint: Create effects and resources during setup or onMount, not in handlers or after await.

rows.when: a code in expect never occurred
rows.message: Expected diagnostic {code} did not occur.
rows.hint: Remove it from expect, or make the test reach that case.

rows.when: settled() timed out
rows.message: settled() timed out after {ms} ms; pending: {list}.
rows.hint: Stub fetch or provide a fake service; raise timeout only for slow real work.

rows.when: a reactive error reached report, or a promise an on* handler returned rejected, during the test (B19.3, B19.6)
rows.message: Reactive code in {ownerPath} threw: {message} (or The promise returned by the {type} handler in {ownerPath} threw: {message})
rows.hint: Fix the error, or wrap the subtree in catchError(() => ..., (err, reset) => ...).

rows.when: @jasno/core/testing resolved without --conditions=development
rows.message: @jasno/core/testing needs the development build of jasno.
rows.hint: Run node with --conditions=development (npm test does).

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: any tsc diagnostic from either program, printed with its related information. Rewrites: TS2835's "Did you mean './x.js'" becomes ./x.ts; TS2554 on a component() value adds "children go in the props object"; TS7022 on the router export prints the COMPONENT_RETURN_TYPE findings first and drops the downstream title error

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: the loaded TypeScript is outside the tested range (~7.0.2), or typescript is not installed

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: the TS API failed to load; tsc ran as a subprocess and the rules that need the syntax tree or types were skipped

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: relative specifier not ending in .ts (.json for JSON modules; dev: 404 for x.js when x.ts exists, with the hint); check also for an entry in index.html ending in .js whose .ts exists

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: syntax that passes tsc and the stripper, then fails in V8

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: syntax that passes tsc and the stripper, then fails in V8

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: private/protected/public/readonly/abstract/override/declare members; use #private

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: using declarations (TS2318 has no location)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: top-level await outside the entry named in index.html (Safari < 27 partial)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: the stripped file does not parse as a module (check parses all files in one process with vm.SourceTextModule and locates a failure with node --check; dev serves a module that throws with file:line:col; dev and dist also report syntax the type stripper refuses, such as enum)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a bare specifier in a browser file that is not @jasno/core, @jasno/core/router, a dependencies package or a package.json "imports" key (dev and dist: one that does not resolve)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: /// <reference types="node" /> or a node: import in a browser file

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: new Worker, new SharedWorker or serviceWorker.register of the DOM globals in a browser file (import maps do not apply to workers, and jasno has no worker recipe)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: assignment to innerHTML/outerHTML/srcdoc, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write/writeln, also through el['innerHTML'] (blocked by the production Trusted Types CSP)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: the DOM's history.pushState/replaceState (error); reading the DOM's location.pathname/location.search in a browser file (warn); a local or parameter named history/location does not count

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: <param>.currentTarget that an await or for await precedes on some path (an await in a block that returns or throws precedes only that block) in an on* handler: an on* prop or method of an h.*/svg.* props object, an addEventListener callback or an el.onx = ... assignment (the DOM sets it to null)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a jasno effect() callback that, during its run, calls fetch, uses .then( or runs an async function (callbacks and listeners it only installs do not count): use resource()

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a value with a zero-parameter call signature (signal or Read) in a template literal

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: in a setup region (the function given to component(), a show/match/catchError callback, an each render; jasno's names resolved through the file's imports) a zero-argument call of a signal or Read whose value lands, through any expression, in a live slot: an h.* prop typed MaybeRead<T> or an h child (h.p(null, count()), step: SAT(sw()) ? '1' : 'any', h.p(null, 'IF ' + f())); reported once per call at the innermost such slot, with the slot named in the message. Nested functions are not entered: handlers and () => bindings read signals rightly, and helper functions called from setup are the runtime's STRICT_READ_UNTRACKED job. A route view's params and data (Fixed<T>, fixed for the view's lifetime, B17.5) are not reported

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: exported PascalCase function returning Node without component()

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: component() given an arrow or anonymous function

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: component function without a return type annotation (: Node) (ADR-06)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a css rule sets outline: none/0 or all: unset/initial/revert on a selector that reaches an interactive element (a button, a, input, select, textarea or summary tag, a [tabindex] or [contenteditable] attribute, *, a :focus* state (a selector part with :not(:focus-visible) keeps the keyboard ring and does not count), or a class the same file puts on an interactive h.* tag in a string class prop), and no css template in the program has a rule for :focus, :focus-visible or :focus-within that declares anything besides outline: none/0 (an outline, box-shadow, border, background, color or text-decoration change counts; sheets are global, ADR-23) (WCAG 2.4.7: programmatic focus moves need a visible indicator)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: new URL('<relative path>', import.meta.url) in a browser file resolves to a file under src/, or jasno dev gets a request for a non-module file under /src/: jasno dist publishes modules there only under hashed names and other files not at all, so the URL 404s in production (put the file in assets/ and use '/assets/<name>')

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a required compiler option missing or changed in either config, esnext.disposable in lib, test files included in the browser program, types other than [] there, test or e2e files with no tsconfig.test.json (a project without them needs none), or package.json without "type": "module" (error); a tsconfig.test.json that matches no file, in place of tsc's TS18003 (warn: the project has no tests yet)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: the entry index.html imports names no file (check; a missing relative import inside src/ is tsc's TS2307 there); dev and dist: a relative or root-relative import in the module graph names no file (dev prints it when it builds the import map; dist fails), and dist also when index.html has no inline module script; a .js specifier whose .ts exists is TS_EXTENSION instead

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a dependency's static closure contains CommonJS, an unguarded process.env read (a typeof process guard is fine) or an unresolvable bare import, or an installed dependency has no entry for the browser/import/default conditions (an optional peer behind import() inside a dependency is not checked)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: an allowlisted directory (src/, assets/, public/) contains .env*, *.pem or *.key, or src/ or assets/ contains a dotfile (public/ dotfiles such as .well-known/ are published)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: browser code imports a module jasno dist does not publish (outside src/, or a *.test.ts file; check reports it at the import); dist also when src/, assets/ or public/ contains a symlink, or a public/ file takes a name dist generates

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: a stylesheet under assets/ imports tailwindcss (@import "tailwindcss") and the project's @tailwindcss/cli is not installed (hint: npm install -D @tailwindcss/cli) or exits non-zero on it (its stderr is in the message); dev answers the request with 500, dist writes nothing (ADR-37)

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: import(expr): the bundle holds only modules imported by string literals, so its target is not in dist/

rows.source: jasno check, jasno dev, jasno dist
rows.when: index.html carries its own CSP <meta>: with 'strict-dynamic' (error), combined with jasno's hash sources it blocks imports in Chromium and Firefox; without it (warn), browsers enforce both policies and the stricter wins, so the app breaks only after deploy
